S x(3,8)
X (p,s) Euclidean rhythm - MAP.md §9.2, still open

S x | ~
X | a random choice - a function, not notation here

S {x x x, x x}
X {} polymeter - one lane has one length; two lanes are two

S x:3
X :n sample index - what a note means is the receiver's (MAP.md §9.4)

S x/2
X /n on a step - one note over n passes; a tie ends with the pass

S <0 3>/2
X /n on a step - one note over n passes; a tie ends with the pass

S <x ~>*2
X * on <> - one member per pass; a faster alternation is a function

S [x x]@2 x
X @ on a group - a tie holds a note here; Strudel stretches the group

S 0 .. 3
X .. a range - a function, not notation

S x*<2 3>
X *<pattern> - a patterned speed is a function

S <x@2 ~>
X @ inside <> - an alternative is one step here, not a length

S bd sd
X a word - a step here is one character; a name is a binding

S 12 3
X a number past 9 - a digit is 0-9 here
